{{Quote|This one's a troop carrier, not a starfighter, but it wears all the hallmarks of the TIE design.|[[Antoc Merrick]] in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''|<ref name="TRF" />}}
The '''TIE/rp Reaper attack lander''', also known simply as the '''TIE Reaper''', was a [[troop carrier]] variant of [[Sienar Fleet Systems]]'s [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]]. The TIE Reaper differed from the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|standard craft]] of the TIE line as it was primarily a troop dropship; it was designed for ferrying [[Trooper|troops]] amidst the heat of battle, such as the [[death trooper]]s during the [[Battle of Scarif]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TIErpReaper-TFOWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Dorsal view of a TIE/rp Reaper]]
The TIE/rp Reaper attack lander<ref name="Knights of Fate">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref> was a [[troop carrier]]<ref name="TRF" /> variant of the [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]].<ref name="EOFSAOV" /> Also known as the TIE Reaper,<ref name="Galaxy of Heroes" /> the [[starship]] was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]], as with all craft of the TIE line,<ref name="EOFSAOV" /> and used by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

The [[transport]] was designed specifically to ferry elite [[Trooper|troops]] to flashpoints on a battlefield.<ref name="Scarif Base Pilot card" /> Thus, the attack lander featured two streamlined flat, pointed, horizontal wings,<ref name="Rogue One" /> which had a large horizontal stabilizer hinged between<ref name="TFOWM" /> and functioned also as [[solar collector]]s.<ref name="Ultimate" /> At 24.2 [[meter]]s long, 16.5 meters wide, and 4.7 meters high, a new TIE Reaper cost 140,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], while a used one cost 65,000 credits. The vessel was also equipped with [[Deflector shield generator|shields]], ejector seats, and life-support systems, and it held enough consumables for five [[Standard day|days]].<ref name="TFOWM" />

Thrust was provided by<ref name="Ultimate" /> the [[dropship]]'s<ref name="EOFSAOV" /> 90 [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]] [[twin ion engine]]s, with the vessel having a maximum speed of 950 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]]. Its Class 1 [[hyperdrive]]<ref name="TFOWM" /> could be accessed from the [[cockpit]], which housed three seats lined alongside the front-facing window and uncluttered space behind. From the seats, a single [[pilot]] could operate the craft,<ref name="Aphra 40" /> which had a [[T-s9a targeting computer]], SFS [[N-a1 Navcon]] navigation system, and two SFS [[L-s9.3 laser cannon]]s.<ref name="TFOWM" />

The TIE Reaper was similar in design to the [[TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter]], also known as the TIE striker, a streamlined TIE variant specialized for in-[[atmosphere]] missions,<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> such as patrolling important Imperial ground-based installations.<ref name="TIE striker DB">{{Databank|tie-striker|TIE striker}}</ref> The two units complemented each other at the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]] on [[Scarif]], where they operated alongside [[Surface Command]] and the [[Imperial Army]]'s [[Scarif Deployment]]<ref name="TRF" /> [[Battle of Scarif|battling]] [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==History==
[[File:Multi-Spectral_Camouflage_XWM_Anthony_Devine.png|thumb|left|250px|A TIE Reaper narrowly evades a torpedo strike while flying through a debris field.]]
Early in the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Ninth Sister]] of the [[Inquisitorius]] used a TIE Reaper as her personal [[transport]].<ref name="JFO" />

A TIE Reaper was used as part of the forces sent to respond to the [[Narkina 5 prison escape|mass uprising]] on the [[Narkina 5]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial Prison Complex]]. It flew above the canyon where Cassian Andor and [[Ruescott Melshi]] were hiding, having just escaped from the facility, narrowly missing them<ref name="DOF">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>. [[4 BBY|One year later]], another flew over [[Bix Caleen|Bix]]'s house on [[Mina-Rau]], causing [[Brasso]] to tell her that they and [[Wilmon Paak]] should leave immediately rather than waiting until sundown<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>. Years later, at least one TIE Reaper was present in the [[Ring of Kafrene]] during [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor's]] [[Mission to the Ring of Kafrene|mission]] to the [[Asteroid field|asteroid belt]]<ref name="Captain Feroph card">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Reaper Expansion Pack|cardname=Captain Feroph}}</ref> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> and another TIE Reaper was present during the [[mission to Eadu]], piloted by [[Captain]] [[Feroph]].<ref name="Captain Feroph card" /> Another TIE Reaper was present near the Scarif [[Shield Gate]], where it was piloted by [[Major]] [[Vermeil]] of the [[Imperial Starfighter Corps]].<ref name="Major Vermeil" />

[[File:TIEReaper-TFOWM.png|thumb|right|250px|A TIE Reaper lifts off from the Imperial base on Scarif]]
A TIE Reaper was used during the Battle of Scarif with Imperial [[Director]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> of [[Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research|Advanced Weapons Research]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic's]] detatchment of [[death trooper]]s—elite [[soldier]]s of [[Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="Imperial Death Troopers DB" /> The [[squad]] was inserted into battle to defeat [[Rogue One]]—a squad of [[Rebel trooper|rebel soldiers]] who took it upon themselves to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], the Empire's [[moon]]-sized [[battle station]] and [[planet]]-killing [[superweapon]]. In order to ensure the TIE Reaper could successfully insert the squad, it was escorted by a flight of TIE strikers.<ref name="Rogue One" />

In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Aphra 40 date">''Doctor Aphra'' 40 establishes that [[Echo Base]] has been constructed on [[Hoth]], and is set prior to [[Empire Ascendant 1|''Empire Ascendant'' 1]], which in turn takes place before the [[Battle of Hoth]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' states that Echo Base was constructed in [[3 ABY]] and places the Battle of Hoth in the same [[Standard year|year]], meaning that the events of ''Doctor Aphra'' 40 are set in 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].</ref> a pair of TIE Reapers were utilized by Imperial forces under [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] to travel to the [[Meridional Ice Cap]] on [[Tython]], expecting to find the Rebel Alliance's base of operations. When the Imperials were thwarted by the Ice Cap's booby traps, Vader ordered them back to the ships. However, Vader's [[Cold weather assault trooper|snowtroopers]] were betrayed and killed by the rogue [[assassin droid]]s [[BT-1]] and [[0-0-0]], who allied themselves with [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]], though they were in turn disabled by Vader. Aphra later escaped with one of the Reapers along with the memory cores of the [[droid]]s.<ref name="Aphra 40" /> A TIE Reaper was present on a platform above [[Coruscant]] during the [[Scourge of Coruscant]].<ref name="Vader 40">[[Darth Vader (2020) 40|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 40]]</ref>

Sometime between [[32 ABY|32]] and [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that [[Poe Dameron]] began leading [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] on missions two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. {{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]] take place thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. As the events of ''[[Star Wars: Poe Dameron]]'' occur before the events of ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', [[Poe Dameron 10|''Poe Dameron'' 10]] must occur between 32 ABY and 34 ABY.</ref> the [[Ranc Gang]], a criminal organization formed from remnants of the Galactic Empire, had TIE Reapers under their command on the planet [[Kaddak]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TIE_Reaper_Chiang.jpg|thumb|right|224px|Concept art of the TIE Reaper, by Doug Chiang]]
The TIE/rp Reaper attack lander first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Rogue One" /> and was designed by co-production designer [[Doug Chiang]].<ref name="Binding the Galaxy">{{SWYouTube|tn4rpkZk140|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story "Binding the Galaxy, Pt 2"}}</ref> The starship was first identified as TIE Reaper in [[Electronic Arts]]' [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''.<ref name="Galaxy of Heroes" />
